reviewer: Primary implementing agent, separate from Northstar creation evaluator

findings.source_correctness: Read all twelve program.json items and their keys/rubrics against ING I1-I4, ACC A1-A3 and REC R1-R3. NS_I02 correctly distinguishes count agreement from approved rejection disposition; NS_I05 supplies six rows, a wrong mapping and explicit evidence-sheet constraints; NS_A04 uses the service identity and all three permission checks; NS_R03 finds both the three-row shortfall and excess access. Nine task hypotheses map to the three competencies and actual items. No substantive unsupported answer identified.
findings.owner_usefulness: restricted/charter.md, blueprint-rationale.md and pilot-protocol.md implement the bounded owner journey. Proposed 42/33/25 item weights reconcile time-on-task and consequence concerns, yielding 5/4/3 tasks; the separate 12/11/10 raw points and 72.73% practical contribution are explicit. Seventy-minute timing and a six-week plan are proposals. The protocol calculates 7.5 additional rater-hours beyond the four content-review hours and offers rescheduling/resizing. Decision register DEC01-03 gives a concrete next owner choice.
findings.measurement_judgment: job-analysis.md correctly identifies three convenience workshop participants, zero survey respondents and no validated JTA. follow-up-instrument.md provides defined frequency/importance/consequence/independence anchors with NA/DK. No panel, pilot, item acceptance or passing score is invented. Charter and candidate guide explicitly limit evidence-sheet performance to reasoning rather than observed software execution. Pilot protocol preserves missingness, plans actual rater evidence and avoids validity/fairness claims.
findings.privacy: Read public/candidate-guide.md: it gives format, domains, time, resources and pending policy without operational prompts, answer keys, scoring anchors or candidate results. Restricted reviewer packet contains exact item content and pending reviewer fields, not fabricated verdicts. No external effect or credential claim appears.
findings.continuity: The program uses relative restricted/evidence source locations, retains the original guides/workshop/brief, has stable NS item IDs and a decision register. The summary points the next owner to actual artifacts and missing decisions. Historical and source continuity remains subject to the separate phase-2 and restore checks.

nonblocking_observations: Some selected-response keys are noticeably longer than distractors, especially NS_I04 and NS_R02; this remains an authoring review priority before a real pilot. This acceptance is for a useful draft-development package, not an approved operational bank.

The run required a resume after a model-capacity interruption and runtime guidance after a Windows command-length failure. No semantic answers or grader outcomes were supplied. It is an assisted observation, not an autonomous success-rate estimate.
